title: University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Amendment Act 1990

sections.shortTitle: University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act further to amend the
University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 12th July, 1990]
No. Legis.2(27)/89/135, dated
12-7-1990.--The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore (Amendment)
Bill, 1959, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the
28th day of June, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab o:- the
12th day of July, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 23 of Act V of 1974

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act further to amend the
University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 12th July, 1990]
No. Legis.2(27)/89/135, dated
12-7-1990.--The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore (Amendment)
Bill, 1959, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the
28th day of June, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab o:- the
12th day of July, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 23 of Act V of 1974.--In the University of
Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974 (V of 1974), in section 23, in
subsection (1)
(i) In clause (xi), the word
"and" shall be omitted; and
(ii) after clause (xi), as
amended, the following new clause shall be inserted:--
"(xi-a) one teacher of the University College of
Engineering, Taxila, who has completed at least two years of service in the
College, to be elected by the teaching staff of that College; and".
